qualification.reason: The document is a 2026-2027 Request for Proposals issued by AmeriCorps NCCC, soliciting partner organizations to apply for teams of volunteers. It includes application instructions, project focus areas, eligibility requirements, and roles/responsibilities for both partners and AmeriCorps NCCC.

quotes.quote: We will notify applicants of award approximately six weeks prior to the project start date.
AmeriCorps NCCC is a federal, national service program for 18- to 24-year-olds that strengthens communities and develops leaders through team-based national and community service.

findings.title: Notification of Award Approximately Six Weeks Prior to Project Start
findings.fact: Applicants will be notified of award approximately six weeks prior to the project start date.

quotes.quote: We will notify applicants of award approximately six weeks prior to the project start date.

findings.title: Lodging Extension for Virtual Training
findings.fact: Partners are to extend lodging for teams Apr 19-22, 2027, so AmeriCorps NCCC staff can deliver virtual training.

quotes.quote: **Partners to extend lodging for teams Apr 19-22, 2027, so AmeriCorps NCCC staff can deliver virtual training.

findings.title: Qualifying Organizations
findings.fact: Qualifying organizations include nonprofit and faith-based organizations, government entities, public schools and universities, and Native American tribal councils.
findings.business_implication: The bidder must confirm that their organization type is explicitly listed as eligible. If not, they may be disqualified from applying.
findings.action_recommendation: Verify eligibility status before investing time in the application. If uncertain, contact the program office for clarification.

quotes.quote: Qualifying organizations include: • Nonprofit and faith-based organizations • Government entities (federal, state, and local) • Public schools and universities • Native American tribal councils

findings.title: Project Dates Subject to Change and Include Travel Time
findings.fact: Project dates are subject to change and include a team's travel time to and from the project.
findings.business_implication: The actual service days may be fewer than expected because travel time is counted within the project dates. Schedule disruptions could occur if dates change.
findings.action_recommendation: Plan for flexibility in project scheduling and account for travel time when estimating the team's available service hours. Maintain open communication with the program to adapt to date changes.

quotes.quote: *Project dates are subject to change and INCLUDE a team’s travel time to and from the project.

findings.title: Application Submission Process
findings.fact: Applications are handled by Assistant Program Directors (APDs). To apply, determine project dates, contact by email, and submit a complete application by the due date.
findings.business_implication: The application process is straightforward but requires proactive communication and adherence to deadlines. Missing the due date or incomplete applications will likely result in rejection.
findings.action_recommendation: Identify desired project dates early, email the provided address to initiate contact, and ensure all required documents are submitted before the deadline. Follow up to confirm receipt.

quotes.quote: Determine the project dates when you’d like to receive a team.
Follow the instructions to submit a complete application by the due date.

findings.title: Federal Tort Claims Act Coverage
findings.fact: AmeriCorps NCCC provides coverage for the team through the Federal Tort Claims Act and Federal Employees’ Compensation Act.
findings.business_implication: The bidder is protected from certain liability claims arising from team activities, reducing their risk exposure. However, coverage may have limitations and conditions.
findings.action_recommendation: Review the specifics of FTCA and FECA coverage to understand what is and isn't covered. Ensure that the project activities fall within the scope of coverage and maintain proper documentation.

quotes.quote: Coverage for the team through the Federal Tort Claims Act and Federal Employees’ Compensation Act
